song.lyrics:
[V1] .E (D) A C#m-B Come to the river of life you will find healing here .E (D) A B Come to the river of life come and drink freely here .C#m G#m F#m B7 Come if your heart is searching, come if your soul is thirsty .E A E A B7 Draw near and drink of the mercy of Jesus Christ . E At the river of life
[V2] .E A B7 E There is a river whose streams make glad . A B7 The city of God, the city of God .A B7 C#m So come if you're wounded or sad . A/F# E A There is a river, there is a river
[C1] . B7 A E It flows from the land of eternal light, . C#m Where there's no more sorrow . A B7 C#m G#m A And no more night into the hearts that are lifted to Him . F#m E G#m A Filling His children again and again and again
song.title: Come to the River of Life
